reviews.text: The people who own this spa are amazing. I highly suggest the head spa. Definitely the best one in north Tucson in my opinion. Sienna did a great job. Will be back for sure

Highly recommend ViVu Lash and Skin. I have been coming to Vi for over 5 years and have always received consistent high quality artistry care for my lashes. She is very detailed and meticulous. Friendly staff and high quality services.
Had my first headspa experience, and it was amazing! They were so kind and thorough, and explained all the steps, my hair has never felt cleaner!
